records.notes: A leading-G APC supports bounded direct RGB/RGBA/PNG worker decode, multipart/query, ID/number replacement, quiet replies, teardown, placement/crop/cursor/z/delete, scroll/clear/reflow, and deterministic CPU/Metal rendering through the ordinary color-atlas frame path. Animation transmit/edit/control/compose/delete uses the same FIFO with 64 total frames per image, 256 extra frames and 16 MiB per screen, atomic generations, exact replies, and eager RGBA state. Visible animations advance at most one displayed frame per monotonic tick through the newest-only scheduler; hidden, occluded, synchronized, and recovery states pause it. Per-frame generations cover CPU/Metal projection, atlas reuse/invalidation, 1x/2x pixels, and renderer replacement. Non-Kitty APC is safe-ignore. File/shared-memory transport, virtual/relative placement, extreme negative z, deterministic resource eviction, and final product animation acceptance remain deferred.
